title: 第5895章 今天必死第5894章 秒杀合道境四重
slug: 天域丹尊第5904章不堪一击
content_zh:
前行了三天之后，苏尘突然心中一动，停下了脚步。
“如果没什么事，不妨一起喝杯茶吧。”
随着苏尘脚步停下，一道声音也是随之响起，带着一股不容置疑的霸气。
苏尘淡淡一笑：“喝茶要看人，至于你？我好像没什么兴趣。”
只见前方有一座亭子，亭中正有一人独自饮茶，白衣轻扬，丰神俊朗。
正是秦雨伯。
“哈哈哈！”
秦雨伯放声大笑，“你的胆子倒是不小。要知道，就是合道境四重在我面前，也都唯唯诺诺，连大气都不敢喘。”
“恭喜你，总算遇到对手了。”
苏尘语气平平。
“对手？还谈不上。”
秦雨伯摇头，“如果今日你已经是四重，或许我还能将你视为对手。可区区二重？我今日便是来杀你的。”
“哦？那你敢不敢和我同阶一战？”
苏尘挑了挑眉，却是用起了激将法。
“苏尘，以我如今的境界和地位，激将法对我又怎么会有用？”
秦雨伯轻笑一声，他早就是公认的万古第一天骄，境界再无提升的可能，也不必担心跌落神坛，自然不会意气用事。
苏尘哈哈一笑：“既然如此，那还说什么废话，尽管来战就是。”
“你本该顺从我的心意，替我去寻找矿脉。”
秦雨伯摇了摇头，脸上露出惋惜之色，“可惜，你非但没有答应，反而杀了我的人。所以今天，你必死无疑！”
他当即出手，轰然一声，右手一翻，苍天竟为之震颤，无数星辰在他掌心诞生，又归于毁灭。

一呼一吸之间，便将宇宙间种种玄妙尽数展现，足见其在武道一途上的深厚领悟。
这赫然是五重级别的战力，苏尘都不必正面硬接，就知道自己绝无抵抗之力。
没办法，两人之间相差整整两个小境界，更何况秦雨伯还是万古第一天骄，即便同阶战力略逊于苏尘，也不会差得太远，两个小境界的差距如何能抹平？
苏尘没有丝毫犹豫，立刻祭出断刀。
轰然之间，一股浓烈煞气喷涌而出，后发先至，径直朝着秦雨伯轰去。
苏尘这举动完全出乎秦雨伯的意料，他当即被那煞气正面击中。这不是寻常的力量冲击，速度远比普通的冲击更快，打了他一个措手不及。
这股煞气是合道境七重历经无尽的杀戮凝聚而成的，不知饮过多少合道境六重的鲜血。即使是秦雨伯这般绝世天骄，也忍不住闷哼一声，眉心裂开一道缝隙，缓缓渗出一缕鲜血。
苏尘心中暗叹，如果自己现在是合道境三重，就具备和秦雨伯一战的资格，即使不敌，想要脱身应该也不难。
但现在只是二重，一旦正面交锋，自己绝对会被瞬间秒杀。
他身形陡然一转，转身就逃。
“苏尘！”
身后传来秦雨伯的怒吼，他已经回过神来，立刻朝着苏尘狂追。
不愧是四重之中的顶级天才，速度快得惊人，即使被断刀的煞气惊扰，也只是迟滞了一瞬而已。
“今天暂且饶你一命，等我合道境四重再来揍你！”
content_en:
After walking for three days, Su Chen suddenly felt something in his heart and stopped.
"If you have nothing else to do, let's have a cup of tea together."
As Su Chen's footsteps stopped, a voice also sounded, with an undoubted domineering air.
Su Chen smiled faintly: "Drinking tea depends on the person. As for you? I don't seem to be interested."
I saw a pavilion in front of me. In the pavilion, there was a man drinking tea alone. His white clothes were fluttering and he looked handsome.
It was Qin Yubo.
"Hahaha!"
Qin Yubo laughed loudly, "You are quite courageous. You know, even in front of me at the fourth level of the Hedao Realm, you are submissive and don't even dare to breathe."
"Congratulations, you finally met your match."
Su Chen's tone was calm.
"Opponent? We can't talk about it yet."
Qin Yubo shook his head, "If you were already at the fourth level today, maybe I could still regard you as an opponent. But only at the second level? I'm here to kill you today."
"Oh? Then do you dare to fight on the same level as me?"
Su Chen raised his eyebrows, but used the provoking method.
"Su Chen, with my current realm and status, how can the Provocation Technique be useful to me?"
Qin Yubo chuckled lightly. He has long been recognized as the most talented person in the world. There is no possibility of improving his realm, and he does not have to worry about falling from the altar. Naturally, he will not be impulsive.
Su Chen laughed: "In that case, why don't you talk nonsense? Just come and fight."
"You should have obeyed my wishes and found mines for me."
Qin Yubo shook his head, with a look of regret on his face, "Unfortunately, instead of agreeing, you killed my people. So today, you will definitely die!"
He immediately took action, with a bang, and with a flip of his right hand, the sky trembled, and countless stars were born and destroyed in his palm.
With each breath, he can reveal all the mysteries of the universe, which shows his profound understanding of the martial arts.
This was clearly a fifth-level combat power. Su Chen knew that he had no power to resist even if he faced it head-on.
There is no way, there is a whole two small realms difference between the two people, not to mention Qin Yubo is still the first genius in the world. Even if the combat power of the same level is slightly inferior to Su Chen, the difference will not be too far. How can the gap between the two small realms be smoothed?
Su Chen didn't hesitate at all and immediately used the broken knife.
Suddenly, a strong evil spirit spurted out, arriving first and heading straight towards Qin Yubo.
Su Chen's move was completely beyond Qin Yubo's expectations, and he was immediately hit head-on by the evil aura. This was not an ordinary impact of force, the speed was much faster than ordinary impact, and it caught him off guard.
This evil spirit was condensed from endless killings at the seventh level of the Hedao Realm. I don’t know how many bloods of the sixth level of the Hedao Realm I drank. Even a peerless genius like Qin Yubo couldn't help but groan, a gap opened between his eyebrows, and a wisp of blood slowly seeped out.
Su Chen secretly sighed in his heart. If he was at the third level of the Hedao Realm, he would be qualified to fight Qin Yubo. Even if he lost, it shouldn't be difficult to escape.
But now it is only the second level. Once there is a head-on confrontation, he will definitely be killed instantly.
He turned around suddenly and ran away.
"Su Chen!"
Qin Yubo's roar came from behind. He had come to his senses and immediately chased Su Chen.
He is indeed the top genius among the fourth level. His speed is astonishing. Even if he is disturbed by the evil spirit of the broken knife, he is only delayed for a moment.
"I'll spare your life for now, and I'll beat you again when I'm at the fourth level of Hedao Realm!"
